title: 7 Best FlutterFlow Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: FlutterFlow alternatives ranked for builders who want a native mobile app without learning a visual canvas. Blink, Adalo, Rork, Draftbit, Thunkable, Replit, Base44: honest pros and cons, real pricing.
body_markdown: It connects to Firebase or Supabase, and features like push notifications and Stripe payments need a Firebase project set up by you, including the Blaze plan for push. Blink provisions a managed SQL database from the prompt.
